answer: A registered walnut cracking mill gives each applicant one press for 120 days, for a 150 token deposit and a 70 dollar license. Sacks arrive weighed at 25 kilos and rest in a stone vault until cracking day. The mill weighs the kernels out and the hollow shells left, so intake minus kernels must match shell weight. A forged tally forfeits the deposit and bars the mill 180 days. Faking 10,000 mills freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 700,000 dollars in licenses. Like a baker who accounts for every loaf and crumb, a mill that cannot show its shells has nothing to sell.
